description: This file defines the class fogbugzdbInterface, which extends issueTrackerInterface to provide integration with FogBugz bug tracking system within the testing framework. It includes methods for constructing bug URLs, fetching bug issues, checking bug existence and syntax, and generating HTML strings for issue status display.

classes.name: fogbugzdbInterface
classes.description: A class extending issueTrackerInterface to interact with FogBugz bug tracking database, providing methods for retrieving issue details, constructing URLs, and generating status display HTML.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, establishes database connection parameters, and configures options.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL to view a specific bug by its ID by encoding the bug ID into the configured URL.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a bug from the database, returning an object with issue details or null if not found.

methods.name: getBugStatus
methods.description: Returns the verbose status of a bug identified by its ID.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks whether a bug with the specified ID exists in the database.

methods.name: buildViewBugLink
methods.description: Generates an HTML link for viewing the bug, styled with a color representing its status.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the format of a bug ID.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Creates an HTML string representing the bug's status with visual cues like strike-through for closed or resolved issues.

methods.name: getMyInterface
methods.description: Returns the PHP interface configuration value.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for configuration XML for setting up the bug tracker integration.
